# users.uploadAvatar — POST /users/me/avatar

Upload an avatar

Sets the avatar of the current user. Any file is accepted; `avatarUrl` becomes `/avatars/<userId><ext>`, where the extension comes from the uploaded file name. Uploading again replaces the avatar.

## Call
```ts
const res = await user.users.uploadAvatar({ body: { file: "./path/to/file" } })
res.assert(201)
```

## Input
```ts
{ body: {
  /** The image file. */
  "file": FileInput
} }
```

## Responses
```ts
201: UserDto // The user with the new `avatarUrl`.
400: ErrorDto // No `file` field in the form.
401: ErrorDto // Missing or invalid bearer token.
```

## Types
```ts
type UserDto = {
  /** User id. */
  "id": number
  /** Email the user registered with. */
  "email": string
  /** Avatar URL. `null` until the user uploads an avatar. */
  "avatarUrl": string | null
}
type ErrorDto = {
  /** HTTP status code. */
  "statusCode": number
  /** Error message. Validation errors (400) return a list: one message per failed constraint. */
  "message": string | Array<string>
  /** HTTP status text, e.g. "Not Found". */
  "error"?: string
}
```
